repos_data.description: A video player for Windows and macOS built on Tauri 2 and libmpv: local files, links, torrent streaming with a built-in catalog, casting to Chromecast and DLNA televisions, and watching together in sync — with an unusual amount of attention to detail.

Candela protects your displays from OLED burn-in and wear: panel health history, a checkup for defects, and the controls macOS leaves out for external monitors (brightness, volume, contrast, custom resolutions, HiDPI scaling). Free and open source.
